prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a GINA parent FAMILY screen and add-child sheet design proposal as TWO full portrait phone screens side by side on a restrained cream presentation board. Reference image is the approved Rewards screen: match its visual system exactly, not a new brand direction. Same cream, violet satin primary buttons, dark indigo rounded Nunito-like clear typography, mint/lilac surfaces, soft tasteful shadows, large readable text, generous 48dp controls. SAME small mint plush reading beside an open book with purple leaves, unchanged character identity. Same small gina wordmark. No giant headings outside phones, no glassmorphism, no gold/black.
LEFT phone: family management overview. Small gina logo and notification bell at top. Back arrow, heading "Ailem", subtitle "Ailenizin ortak alanı." Small reading mascot upper right. A compact mint invitation panel "Aileye davet" with clearly fictional code "DEMO2026" and helper "Diğer ebeveyn bu kodla aileye katılabilir." Children section heading "Çocuklar". Two neat cream cards: illustrated Ece portrait, "Ece", "2. sınıf", secondary lilac "Çocuk ayarları" button; Can portrait, "Can", "5. sınıf", same button. Single tidy accordion row "Cihazlar ve PIN" with lock icon and chevron, collapsed. Prominent anchored purple "+ Çocuk ekle" button ABOVE bottom navigation "Bugün", "Takvim", "Prova", "Diğer", with Diğer selected. Clearly separate existing profiles from the primary add action. The page is scrollable; other account sections will continue below, don't cram them into this viewport.
RIGHT phone: full-height cream Add Child sheet. Heading "Çocuk ekle", X top right. Small familiar reading mascot upper right, short helpful copy "Adını yaz, birlikte bir avatar seçin." Label "Çocuğun adı", field "Deniz". Label "Avatar", 6 illustrated child avatar choices in a well-spaced 3 by 2 grid of circular pastel tiles; first selected with violet ring, inclusive varied hairstyles and skin tones. These are existing selectable avatars, NOT extra fields. Preview cream/lilac card "Yeni profil", selected avatar and "Deniz". Modest note "Çocuk PIN’ini profil oluşturduktan sonra ayarlayabilirsin." Fixed bottom secondary "Vazgeç", primary violet "Profili oluştur". Do not add date of birth, gender, school name, grade input, paid upgrade or new feature. This is a design proposal; exact implementation will use native text and existing logo/avatar assets. Carefully align controls and leave room for long translated text.
notes: Design proposal only. parent/menu code is unchanged.
Existing avatar and brand assets remain implementation sources; generated lettering and avatars are not replacement assets.
DEMO2026 is fictional. Copy-code affordance is a proposed convenience, not an existing implemented feature.

The menu remains scrollable. Device pairing/revocation, child/parent PIN, profile deletion, subscription, sharing, notifications, sign-out and account deletion must remain reachable when implementing.
No grade editing, gender or birthday fields proposed; current create-child data remains name and avatar.
